Azure Berserk cosmetic ability scroll (untradeable) is a potential reward from Santa's Christmas Presents.

Builder's shirt.x: The builder's shirt is a shirt used in the Tower of Life quest to gain access to the tower. To get it you have to give The 'Guns' a beer. Upon completion of the Deadliest Catch quest, players can find The 'Guns' near the Fishing Guild bank and use a beer on him to obtain another Builder's shirt.

Someone killing either aquanites, dagannoths, or mogres can find a bunyip very useful as well, because they mainly drop raw fish. Adrenaline is not lost when "eating" a raw fish.
If the player has the exact Cooking level needed to cook a fish, it may be helpful just to bring only the raw version of it so that none are wasted by burning. Thus, using the special move may save money on that part. Players do not get Cooking experience for using the scroll. The Cooking level cannot be assisted.

sc: It can be redeemed to unlock the Cottontail Knight chestplate and Cottontail Knight gauntlets overrides, destroying the token in the process.
Crystal Peacock armour is a cosmetic override that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be unlocked by redeeming RuneScape Membership Card or by being a Premier Club member from 1 September 2016 to 30 September 2016.
Though the Distractions and Diversions specific tokens are no longer obtainable in game, an item with a similar function known as a D&D token was later released.
A deathcress robe top is tier 2 necromancy tank body armour available in Daemonheim as part of the deathcress armour set.
It is made from ensouled wildercress cloth and ensouled thread with level 18 Crafting.
Decimation is a degradable tier 87 two-handed chargebow, available as a reward from Slayer as a possible drop from a Wilderness slayer chest.
It can be traded again after being fully repaired.
An enchanted bird's nest is an item which can be obtained while chopping an eternal magic tree.
Players have a 1% chance—increased to 2% at level 107 Woodcutting—to obtain this type of bird's nest while under the effects of Lumberjack's Intuition.
The enchanter's echo wand is a main hand magic weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 17 of the Kerapac Track while having access to the premier rewards.
Faceless Enforcer Greataxe is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked through the Assassin's Return promotion from Treasure Hunter.

Feathered serpent skirt (purple, female).x: The purple feathered serpent skirt is part of the feathered serpent outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: The fractite hatchet is a tier 5 hatchet that can only be obtained and used while in Daemonheim.
It can be made from one fractite bar, requiring level 42 Smithing and giving 47 Smithing experience.
The gnome emissary fragment is an item obtained during the Birthright of the Dwarves quest.

Golden warpriest of Bandos boots.x: The golden warpriest of Bandos boots is a hybrid boot armour that can be won from the Balthazar's Big Raffle (except the 2015 raffle) and is part of the Golden warpriest of Bandos armour set.

sc: The grand ranging potion is a combination potion that can be made at level 76 Herblore after unlocking the recipe.
It is made by combining a super ranging potion (4) and a ranging potion (4) in a crystal flask, giving 144.
A green satchel is a drop from unicows in the Creature Creation activity.
Other colours of satchels are available from the Creature Creation minigame.
The holy overload potion is a combination potion that can be made at level 97 Herblore after unlocking the recipe.
It is made by combining an overload (4) with a prayer renewal (4) in a crystal flask, giving 350 experience.
A huge meteorite is an item that can be won through Treasure Hunter as part of the Meteor Storm promotion added on 21 January 2016.

The Hunter master cape is the Cape of Accomplishment that can be bought from the hunting expert and from Elen Anterth in the Max Guild for 120,000 coins after having achieved true skill mastery by reaching virtual level 120 Hunter, requiring to 104,273,167 experience.
The infected zombie legs is a reward from the Walk Like a Zombie promotion.
The Inverted Firemaking skillcape token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that reach level 99 Firemaking during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).
It, along with the regular Woodcutting master skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached virtual level 120 Woodcutting.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Woodcutting master skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has virtual level 120 Woodcutting.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 iron bars, requiring 400 progress to complete, granting a total of 80 Smithing experience.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like tiny spiky iron salvage by the spring cleaner.
It is given to the player by Gunnjorn, who is inside the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course after starting the quest, and is used to unlock the door to the lighthouse north of the Barbarian Outpost.
If lost, it can be re-obtained from Gunnjorn; however, you do not need to use the key to unlock the lighthouse after you have already unlocked the door once.
It can also be re-obtained at May's Quest Caravan after putting 150 quest points into the Hub Track.
The medium fortune star (Fletching) is a reward for completing a cloud of destiny in the Fletching skill, as part of the Spring Fayre event.

Although only members can smith this sword and it is untradeable, the wield option and the stats are available in free-to-play.

It was originally unlocked by completing tier 3 of the The Knight Before Christmas event while having access to premier rewards and was later available for a time from the Marketplace for oddments.
It can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It can be created at level 97 Smithing from four promethium bars.
